title: Content Schematic
description: Input contract for the content-build pass (Phase 5). Derived deterministically from the approved Menu Spec (deriveContentSchematic / derive_content_schematic), enriched by the content-interpreter sub-agent (run_content_interpretation) from the client PDF. Structure is owned by the derivation — entries are keyed 1:1 to content-bearing Menu Spec nodes and may never be added/removed/rekeyed by hand or by the interpreter. See the KB doc kb/content-schematic-schema via read_agent_doc.

site.description: Active site URL this schematic targets.

source.description: Client PDF filename the content details come from.

menu_spec_file.description: Workspace filename of the Menu Spec this schematic was derived from.

generated.description: Date the schematic was first derived (YYYY-MM-DD).

derived_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent derive/merge (ISO 8601). Updated by every re-derive.

open_questions.description: Content facts the PDF didn't provide — pull URLs, missing copy, ambiguous instructions. Same convention as the Menu Spec.

assumptions.description: Defaults the content-interpreter applied, made reviewable.

node_key.description: Stable key linking this entry to its Menu Spec node. Menu nodes: '<menu>:<title path>' joined with '/' (e.g. 'mainmenu:About Us/Our Staff'). Grid members: 'grid:<page>/<member title>'. Assigned by the derivation — never edit.

title.description: Article/page title (the grid member title for grid_member entries).

menu_path.description: Human-readable menu location; for grid members, the grid page's path.

category.description: Joomla category the article lives in (from the spec node / grid).

joomla_article_id.description: Joomla article ID, stamped from spec.joomla_ids.articles by the post-Phase-4 re-derive. Content-build falls back to a title search when absent.

spec_notes.description: Verbatim copy of the spec node's notes field (derive-owned).

instructions.description: Rich per-page directive extracted from the client PDF by the content-interpreter.

source_url.description: Concrete URL to pull content from (content_source: pull). 'TBD' allowed only with a matching open_questions entry.

copy.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim copy the PDF supplies for this page.

assets.description: Images/documents/media the PDF references for this page.

features.description: Special page features beyond plain article text — widgets, forms, calendars, galleries, staff grids.

kind.description: Feature slug, e.g. 'calendar-feed', 'quick-gallery', 'jotform'. Free string — the KB set grows.

kb_ref.description: KB doc name that covers building this feature, e.g. 'kb/ministry-platform-widget'.

source_file.description: Workspace path of the fetched source markdown (stamped by fetch_source_content), e.g. 'stmarys-source/03-welcome.md'.

content_file.description: Workspace path of the final page HTML (stamped by the content-writer harness), e.g. 'stmarys-html/03-welcome.html'.

draft.description: True when the writer generated the page from scratch (content_source: generate) — flag for human review.

applied_at.description: Timestamp the HTML was applied to the Joomla article (ISO 8601). Set by apply_content on success.
